responsibility: Implements the Rust frontend’s concrete mapping logic for compiler-recognized language items. This file defines the bidirectional table between #[lang = "..."] strings and LangItem::Kind values, provides Parse and ToString conversion helpers, and translates internal operator enums into the corresponding lang items for arithmetic, compound assignment, and negation traits, supporting resolver and semantic handling of overloaded operations and builtin trait names.
same_name_distinction: Implementation side of the rust-lang-item stem: it defines the concrete BiMap table from lang-item strings to LangItem::Kind and the conversion functions from strings and operator enums. The companion rust-lang-item.h, which is in the same same-name group but not a target here, provides the enum and function declarations.
